gist: England beat New Zealand 37-12 in a repeat of last year.
England played with a more fluid and less predictable style.
New Zealand struggled after a long and tiring schedule.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: England secured a 37-12 victory over New Zealand in front of 81,953 fans. Unlike last year when they relied heavily on kicking, England played a more fluid passing game and scored tries through clever movement. Ben Earl made 33 carries, while the forward pack and defence dominated the match against a depleted visiting side.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Steve Borthwick's team has experienced many false dawns and fluctuating form over four years. This win suggests England may have developed a more sustainable tactical approach and deeper squad balance to challenge rugby superpowers ahead of next year's World Cup.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: New Zealand will face England again next Saturday at Allianz Stadium in the Nations Championship third-place play-off. Meanwhile, England's next major challenge will be an away match against Ireland in the Six Nations tournament next February.

gist: Australia defeated Wales in a close Nations Championship match in Cardiff.
Wales fought back with tries from Dewi Lake and Blair Murray.
Australia held on despite a late yellow card to secure victory.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Australia edged past Wales in a tight contest at the Principality Stadium. Tries from Taniela Tupou, Brandon Paenga-Amosa, Max Jorgensen and Len Ikitau helped the visitors build a lead. Wales responded through captain Dewi Lake who scored twice, alongside a try from Blair Murray, but Australia ultimately held on for the win.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The victory ended a four-match losing run for Australia and secured the Nations Championship spoils. For Wales, the defeat highlighted missed attacking opportunities after they failed to capitalise on their chances following their previous notable win against New Zealand.

sections.heading: What happens next

sections.heading: What happened
